Title: Broadside – James Bleecker, Auctioneer. Chancery Sale. Valuable Property in Prince Street. Bllker & Van Dyke will sell at auction on Tuesday, February 15th, at 12 o'clock, at the Merchant's Exchange, All that certain House and Lot of ground on the northerly side of Prince street, being the centre house between Crosby and Orange streets...known as No. 65 Prince street
